notice: Published measurements of other hardware. Multiplying them by a token count does not measure the computer running Lunri.

assumptions.input_policy: Input tokens are not converted. The cited fit attributes almost all of the measured energy to output length.
assumptions.boundary: One NVIDIA A100. nvidia-smi power minus a 10-second idle baseline. Net GPU energy only, not the wall plug.
assumptions.detail: Section 4.3.1, accessed 2026-11-23. The paper's output-length fit is E = 1.72 * L_out - 6.48 joules. Lunri uses the stated marginal 1.72 J per generated token and does not subtract the intercept.

assumptions.input_policy: The cited figure is energy per output token. Input tokens are not converted.
assumptions.boundary: Llama 3.1 8B on NVIDIA H100 GPUs, batch size 64, vLLM 0.11.1. GPU energy, not a wall-plug reading.
assumptions.detail: Accessed 2026-11-23. The page states that the 8B model at batch size 64 fell from 0.20 J to 0.12 J per token on the newer vLLM stack. Lunri uses 0.12.
